text:
sam: Kicking off account activation for org 'orion' — need GPUs + EIPs in us-west1 (GCP), eu-west-1 (AWS), and westeurope (Azure). Need quota increases and tag + billing enforcement. Posting checklist.

noah: Thanks — which GPU SKUs and counts?

sam: Target: 8xA100-40GB in us-west1 (GCP), 16xp4d in eu-west-1 (AWS), and 4xNC A100 v4 in Azure. Initial burst for testing: 2-4 in each region.

li: For GCP we'll need both 'accelerator.coreCount' and 'CPUs' quotas. Also requesting reserved static external IPs (EIP) — default quota is 7 per region. We should request 50.

maria: Tagging rules: env=orion, owner=team-orion, cost_center=platform. We'll enforce via org policy. I'll attach the policy snippet.

sam: Policy snippet:
```json
{"constraint":"constraints/compute.restrictCreateExternalIp","allowedValues":["projects/12345"],"condition":null}
```

archit: For AWS, open a case for Elastic GPUs? Actually for p4d we need ENI and EBS throughput checks. Also increase Elastic IPs to 100 and vCPU quota in target AZs.

noah: Azure: request 'NC A100 v4' quota via Azure portal support. Also check regional core limits — default 10 cores per region.

sam: Cost note: prefer spot/preemptible for testing. In production we commit reserved capacity on Dedicated. Approx cost delta: spot ~70% cheaper.

li: I'm running a quick quota audit now:
```bash
python infra/tools/quota_audit.py --org orion --regions us-west1,eu-west-1,westeurope
```

infra-bot: Ticket created: AWS case 1234567890 (p4d & EIP increase). GCP case 987654321 (accelerator quota). Azure support request 555-ORION-AZ.

maria: Please include tagging enforcement timeline — we want org policy live before any VM creation.

sam: I'll hold off on provisioning until tickets are confirmed. I'll update with ETA once we hear back.

archit: Also add VPC subnet size: use /20 subnets for compute pools, /24 for bastion/subnets. Egress NAT gateway throughput: request increase to 10 Gbps for us-west1.

noah: +1 on /20. Also note that some CSPs charge for static IPs; include that in cost estimate.

sam: Action items:
- sam: open support tickets (done — see bot)
- li: run quota audit and share CSV
- maria: prepare org policy & tag enforcement (ETA EOD)
- archit: prepare network sizing doc and cost estimate

li: Audit finished. Uploading CSV to s3://infra-ops/orion/quota-audit-2243012345.csv

sam: Thanks all. Will follow up once tickets resolve. :thumbsup:
